standard_prerequisites.use: Proper pushforward of coherent sheaves on spaces (Cohomology of Spaces, lemma-proper-pushforward-coherent), the schemes formal functions theorem (Cohomology of Schemes, lemma-inverse-systems-push-pull), and the etale-descent formalism for Coh(X, I) set up in the chapter's preceding section.

core_obligations: Define the comparison maps from adjunction plus the given completed isomorphism.
Use uniqueness and etale descent to reduce to affine bases.
Import the schemes theorem for the final identification.

proof_roadmap.step: Coherence of the pushforward makes alpha land in the right category.
Etale reduction to affines and the schemes formal functions result.

difficulty_reason: For a representable proper map f : X -> Y of Noetherian algebraic spaces, quasi-coherent ideals J on Y and K controlling the open locus where f is an isomorphism, an inverse system (G_n) in Coh(Y, J), a coherent F on X and an isomorphism beta from the completed pullback of (G_n) to the I-adic completion of F in Coh(X, I), the lemma produces a map alpha : (G_n) -> (f_*F)^ in Coh(Y, J) whose kernel and cokernel are annihilated by a power of K. The retained proof is written: coherence of f_*F (Cohomology of Spaces, lemma-proper-pushforward-coherent) makes the statement meaningful; the candidate maps gamma_n are the compositions of the adjunction map with F/I^n F through beta; uniqueness and existence are established etale locally on Y using descent for the filtered category (the chapter's preceding discussion), reducing to Y the spectrum of a Noetherian ring, where representability makes X a scheme and the claim becomes the schemes theorem (Cohomology of Schemes, lemma-inverse-systems-push-pull) whose proof is quoted as the model. Retained author proof at lines 9962-9987.
